gloss: to sally forth; to reel out; to launch

definitions.gloss: to go out in a group, to sally forth, to head out
definitions.explanation: To set out or venture forth, especially in a group or with enthusiasm. Often used for going out to enjoy oneself or heading somewhere with energy.

definitions.gloss: to reel out, to let out, to unleash
definitions.explanation: To send out or deploy something one after another, such as attacks, techniques, or thread from a spool.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{街|まち}へ{繰|く}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: We head out to town on weekends.

examples.japanese: {花見|はなみ}シーズンになると{大勢|おおぜい}の{人|ひと}が{公園|こうえん}に{繰|く}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: When cherry blossom season arrives, crowds of people head out to the parks.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}には{家族|かぞく}{連|づ}れが{遊園地|ゆうえんち}や{動物園|どうぶつえん}に{繰|く}り{出|だ}して、どこも{賑|にぎ}わっていた。
examples.english: On holidays, families headed out to amusement parks and zoos, and everywhere was bustling.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}々と{技|わざ}を{繰|く}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To unleash one technique after another.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}はパンチを{繰|く}り{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: The opponent launched punches at me.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}は{得意|とくい}の{連続技|れんぞくわざ}を{繰|く}り{出|だ}して、{観客|かんきゃく}を{沸|わ}かせた。
examples.english: The player unleashed a series of signature moves, exciting the audience.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), す-ending.
- Negative: {繰|く}り{出|だ}さない
- Polite: {繰|く}り{出|だ}します
- Te-form: {繰|く}り{出|だ}して
- Past: {繰|く}り{出|だ}した

USAGE:
Sense 1 is intransitive and describes people heading out somewhere. Sense 2 is transitive and describes deploying or unleashing things in succession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街|まち}に{繰|く}り{出|だ}す: to head out to town
- {技|わざ}を{繰|く}り{出|だ}す: to unleash techniques
- {次|つぎ}々と{繰|く}り{出|だ}す: to send out one after another
